title: Satori business app package
description: Scaffolds an app definition package, version 2: app.json, labels/en.json, the OSGi component that contributes its layouts and its app to the app registry, and version 1's package files with the generator's build.mjs. With type and a content model it writes the first record page: the pipeline refuses a package that contributes nothing. app-layout, app-queue and app-action add to it.

name.description: Marketplace package name, kebab-case, at most 128 characters. Also the directory and the component's file name.

owner.description: Owner prefix for the Nuxeo component and bundle, as in <owner>.config.<name>. Component names must be unique on a server.

appId.description: The app's id in the registry, app.json's id: lower-case letters, digits and '-', at most 63 characters. It stays the same from one version to the next, and begins the labels' keys. Defaults to the package name.

address.description: Where the shell is to open the app, under its own address: app.json's address, of the same form as appId, which it defaults to. Refused when it is a platform route, such as contracts (PLATFORM_ROUTES in libs/shared/app-definition), as the pipeline refuses it: an app id that is one needs an address.

title.description: The app's name, as 'Switch app' lists it, and the Marketplace title. Defaults to the name in title case.

vendor.description: Vendor shown in the Marketplace listing. Defaults to the title.

version.description: The package version, written in package.xml, app.json's packageVersion and the manifest's Bundle-Version.

platform.description: The platform versions the app runs on, as a range: '>=0.2.0 <1.0.0', '^1.2.0' or '~1.2.0'. Defaults to libs/platform's version up to its next major.

groups.description: The groups the app is for, separated by commas. 'members' is everyone, and the default. Not a security control: Nuxeo's permissions still decide what anyone reads.

directory.description: Parent directory for the package: a relative path of letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'. The package pipeline's workflow checks every package under business-apps/packages/.

type.description: The document type of the first record page, written as app-layout writes it. The pipeline refuses a package that contributes nothing, so without it the package passes only once app-layout has added a layout.

model.description: With type: the content model, a file `npm run app-package:model` exported.

modelServer.description: With type: read the content model live from this Nuxeo instead, with NUXEO_USER and NUXEO_PASS from the environment.

schemas.description: With type: the schemas to show, separated by commas, as app-layout takes them.
